title: MAINTENANCE: advance_state concurrency contract undocumented
description:
/crates/kith-store/src/contact.rs:151
/crates/kith-store/src/chat.rs:166
/crates/kith-store/src/message.rs:346

All three modules use identical UPDATE+SELECT pattern for state counter advance:
  UPDATE state_counters SET counter = counter + 1 WHERE type_name = ?
  SELECT counter FROM state_counters WHERE type_name = ?

This is a READ-COMMITTED transaction (not atomic). Safe in Phase 1 (single-threaded),
but the contract is not documented.

Risk: Future maintainer adding async/threaded delivery loop would unknowingly introduce
race conditions where two threads could read the same counter value.

Solution: Add explicit doc comment to each advance_state method:
  /// Increments state counter and returns the new value.
  /// SAFETY: Only safe for single-threaded access. Phase 1 is single-threaded;
  /// multi-threaded callers must wrap this in a transaction.

Impact: Protects against accidental concurrency bugs in Phase 2+.
